nodes.label: Dual monitor xrandr layout (eDP-1 + HDMI-1 primary)
nodes.norm_label: dual monitor xrandr layout (edp-1 + hdmi-1 primary)

nodes.label: globalkeys
nodes.rationale: Tag keys use keycodes (#i+9) to work on any keyboard layout

nodes.label: Launcher keys (terminal, rofi drun, copyq, thunar, menubar)
nodes.norm_label: launcher keys (terminal, rofi drun, copyq, thunar, menubar)

nodes.label: Super+D show desktop / restore
nodes.rationale: Windows-like: minimize everything, press again to bring it back

nodes.label: Floating clients rule (copyq, pinentry, Arandr, Tor Browser...)
nodes.norm_label: floating clients rule (copyq, pinentry, arandr, tor browser...)
nodes.rationale: Tor Browser needs fixed window size to avoid fingerprinting

nodes.label: onNvidia PRIME offload wrapper
nodes.rationale: Run Craft app GUIs on the NVIDIA GPU via PRIME offload while leaving <app>-cli (used by MCP servers) untouched.

nodes.label: programs.craftapps (all Craft apps, skill + MCP enabled)
nodes.norm_label: programs.craftapps (all craft apps, skill + mcp enabled)

nodes.label: graphify skill, CLI and hooks
nodes.rationale: Hooks nudge searches/reads toward graphify query in projects with a graph; SessionStart installs git hooks to rebuild graph on commit/checkout/merge.

nodes.label: impeccable skill
nodes.rationale: Only the skill is linked, not the plugin, since its hooks would run the engine on every edit.

nodes.label: permissions (auto mode, deny .env and secrets reads)
nodes.norm_label: permissions (auto mode, deny .env and secrets reads)

nodes.label: rea MCP server (rea-agents via npx)
nodes.rationale: Skill gives the workflow, MCP server gives the tools; npx runs the release matching the pinned skill source version.

nodes.label: replica-skill skills (replica-*)
nodes.rationale: Skills kept at repo root, so each is linked individually instead of as a plugin.

nodes.label: rtk Bash output condenser + RTK.md
nodes.rationale: Rewrites Bash commands through a PreToolUse hook so output is condensed before reaching Claude; RTK.md generated from the same binary.

nodes.label: token-savior MCP server
nodes.rationale: Structural code navigation and persistent memory to spend fewer tokens; built locally since not in nixpkgs, with tree-sitter Java/Ruby grammars from GitHub.

nodes.label: watermarks-remover plugin + PostToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: Plugin's hooks.json removed and hook registered directly with python3 so Node isn't needed.

nodes.label: Global git ignores (claude settings.local, graphify-out state)
nodes.norm_label: global git ignores (claude settings.local, graphify-out state)
nodes.rationale: graphify local state ignored; graph.json and GRAPH_REPORT.md stay trackable.

nodes.label: nixpkgs-graphify flake input
nodes.rationale: graphify kept on its own nixpkgs, updated separately with nix flake update nixpkgs-graphify

nodes.label: rea flake input
nodes.rationale: Pinned to a release so it matches the rea-agents MCP server

nodes.label: token-savior flake input
nodes.rationale: MCP server source, packaged in claude-code.nix

nodes.label: vercel-skills flake input
nodes.rationale: Source of the find-skills skill; the skills package ships only the CLI

nodes.label: graphify overlay (.nix as documents, graphify-python wrapper)
nodes.norm_label: graphify overlay (.nix as documents, graphify-python wrapper)
nodes.rationale: graphify runs sys.executable -m graphify for workers/hooks/merge driver, so sys.executable points at a python with its modules; graphify has no Nix parser so .nix is added to DOC_EXTENSIONS for semantic extraction

nodes.label: MySQL disabled in favour of docker-compose
nodes.norm_label: mysql disabled in favour of docker-compose
nodes.rationale: mysql held the port needed by docker compose; disabled rather than change compose port

nodes.label: systemd user service caffeine (caffeine-ng)
nodes.rationale: services.caffeine.enable is broken, so a manual systemd user unit is used instead.

nodes.label: kitty remote control (socket-only, unix:/tmp/kitty)
nodes.rationale: Needed by terminal-browser to open splits.

nodes.label: com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar D-Bus service
nodes.rationale: Awesome acts as registrar so Qt/Electron apps export menus over dbusmenu; location stored as X property to survive restarts

nodes.label: Firefox hardening policies (telemetry off, tracking protection, extensions locked)
nodes.norm_label: firefox hardening policies (telemetry off, tracking protection, extensions locked)

nodes.label: /usr/share/fonts tmpfiles symlink
nodes.rationale: The craft apps only look for fonts in /usr/share/fonts and ignore fontconfig
